name: tooltip
useFor: Use to explain an icon button or an info glyph in a few words (Tunnel, Connection, TLS). Wrap a toolbar or page in TooltipProvider so neighboring tooltips open at once after the first.
constraints: Essential information only in a tooltip
Sentences longer than one line or two
